paper_title: Audio-Visual Efficient Conformer for Robust Speech Recognition
caption: Audio-only back-end modules FLOPs (Billion).

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the module Giga FLOPs across different stages of an audio back-end Conformer, with a focus on different attentional mechanisms and feed-forward processes. The category axis is the horizontal axis labeled as "Audio back-end Conformer Stage", featuring three stages: Stage 1 (d=180, n=500), Stage 2 (d=256, n=250), and Stage 3 (d=360, n=125). The value axis is the vertical axis labeled "Module Giga FLOPs," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.3, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Four bars are depicted in each stage, each representing a distinct module, using different colors: "attention" in blue, "grouped attention (g=3)" in red, "patch attention (k=3)" in yellow, and "feed-forward" in green. In Stage 1, the "attention" bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 0.28 Giga FLOPs, while the "patch attention" bar is the shortest, at about 0.1 Giga FLOPs. In Stage 2, the "attention" bar is at 0.15 which is longest, while "patch attention (k=3)" in yellow is shortest for 0.1. For Stage 3, the "feed forward" has the longest bar with a value around 0.1, while "patch attention (k=3)" is the shortest. To match different bar color with their labels, a legend is available on top of chart.
